items.title: Nvidia RTX 5090 shipment worth $470,000 goes missing in Brazilian airport
items.description: Brazilian electronics and IT distributor Oderço claims that two pallets of Zotac RTX 5090 GPUs have arrived at the airport but has since completely disappeared.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 13 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A Brazilian electronics and IT distributor, Oderço, has gone on Instagram after failing to find answers about a missing shipment of RTX 5090 GPUs worth around $470,000 or R$2,500,000. According to its Instagram post [machine translated], the company has never faced an experience like this in its 38-year history. It was expecting two pallets of Zotac RTX 5090 GPUs at Guarulhos International Airport in São Paulo, which supposedly arrived there but then disappeared. The company has not provided any details, like the shipment’s arrival date or any tracking numbers, but claims that there hasn’t been any official response regarding its shipment inquiries. Because of this, the company went on the social media platform pleading for answers.A post shared by Oderço (@odercodistribuidora)RTX 5090s are currently in short supply across the world, with the top-tier card disappearing from online retailers in the middle of September. There have been rumors that Nvidia has ceased production of the GPU to focus on more expensive professional AI cards, although it insists otherwise. Still, it doesn’t help that the flagship GPU is marked “not carried” in Micro Center’s online retail store, making it insanely difficult to find one of the best gaming GPUs you can buy today.We don’t have any idea how many GPUs are missing, as the distributor only mentioned two pallets’ worth of RTX 5090s. A Zotac Gaming GeForce RTX 5090, which goes for around $8,000 on Amazon presently, is listed at R$33,999.99 on a Brazilian online retailer Promotech. This means that the company is missing 63 GPUs at the minimum, although this is likely going to be so much more considering that the $R2,500,000 amount the company said is its acquisition cost, not the retail price that it’s expected to go for.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: We’ve seen various scams where retail customers lose their GPU shipments on the way to their home or delivery address, as well as unscrupulous buyers stripping off the GPU core and memory modules from an RTX 5090 and then shipping it back to the seller. This also isn’t the first instance that a shipment of high-value graphics cards has been stolen — one brazen crew has even rammed security escorts to hijack an AI hardware shipment, while another group stole two trailers marked with the Nvidia logo, only to find that it contained sand. items.titleZh: 价值47万美元的英伟达RTX 5090货件在巴西机场失踪
items.descriptionZh:
巴西电子与IT分销商Oderço近日在Instagram公开求助，原因是其一批发往圣保罗瓜鲁柳斯国际机场的Zotac GeForce RTX 5090显卡货物失踪。公司称，这批货物为两托盘RTX 5090，价值约47万美元（约250万雷亚尔），但货物据称抵达机场后却不知所踪。Oderço表示，在其38年经营历史中从未遇到类似情况，且公司就货物查询始终未获得正式回应，因此选择通过社交媒体公开寻求答案。原文未披露货物具体到达日期、追踪编号或承运细节，也未说明失踪显卡的确切数量；按其披露的采购成本和巴西零售商Promotech标价33,999.99雷亚尔/块推算，原文估计至少涉及63块GPU，但由于250万雷亚尔是采购成本而非零售价，实际数量可能更多。

这一事件发生在RTX 5090全球严重缺货的背景下。作为英伟达当前旗舰级游戏GPU，RTX 5090自9月中旬起从多家在线零售商处消失，市场供应极为紧张。原文提到，有传闻称英伟达已停止该GPU生产，以将产能转向价格更高的专业AI卡，但英伟达否认这一说法。与此同时，美国Micro Center线上商店将这款旗舰GPU标记为“not carried”，进一步加剧了消费者购买难度。价格方面，Zotac Gaming GeForce RTX 5090在亚马逊上目前售价约8,000美元，而在巴西在线零售商Promotech的标价为33,999.99雷亚尔。高售价、稀缺供应和强劲需求共同抬高了该产品的黑市价值和运输风险。

从技术影响和应用场景看，RTX 5090属于高端消费级GPU，主要面向顶级游戏、内容创作和高性能计算需求；在当前AI算力需求旺盛、专业AI加速卡价格更高的市场环境下，旗舰游戏GPU的短缺也会波及工作站和小型AI部署等场景。原文并未披露RTX 5090的具体技术参数或产品创新点，新闻核心是高端GPU供应链中的物流失窃与短缺问题。此次案件并非孤立事件：原文回顾了多类GPU相关犯罪，包括零售客户在配送途中丢失显卡、买家拆走RTX 5090的GPU核心和显存后把空卡退回卖家，以及犯罪团伙驾车冲撞安保押运车辆劫持AI硬件运输、偷走带有英伟达标志的拖车却发现里面装的是沙子等案例。这些事件表明，高价值GPU已成为有组织犯罪的目标，分销商和零售商需要加强运输安保、保险、全程追踪、交接验证和防拆封措施，否则缺货与高价将进一步刺激盗窃和欺诈风险。对Oderço而言，此次事件不仅带来约47万美元的直接财务损失，也可能影响其供货能力和渠道信誉；对终端市场而言，则可能进一步加剧RTX 5090的短缺和价格波动。

items.title: Web-based chip fab engineering game goes viral in Taiwan
items.description: A new 3D web game where you live 'A Day in the Life of a Semiconductor Wafer Factory Worker' has gone viral in Taiwan, where it was developed.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A new 3D web game where you live "A Day in the Life of a Semiconductor Wafer Factory Worker" has gone viral in Taiwan, where it was developed. Available in Chinese, English, and Japanese, Fab24hr is a work simulator where you play one of several semiconductor engineer roles in a blocky isometric 3D factory. Though the graphics might look basic, Taiwan’s TVBS news says that the game is so realistic that it resonates with fab workers but not always in a good way – some have likened it to "a horror game" or "prison" [machine translation]. Image 1 of 5 (Image credit: Fab24hr) (Image credit: Fab24hr) (Image credit: Fab24hr) (Image credit: Fab24hr) (Image credit: Fab24hr) Image 1 of 5 View Original Image 2 of 5 View Original Image 3 of 5 View Original Image 4 of 5 View Original Image 5 of 5 View Original If you head over to the Fab24hr site, the game UI loads pretty quickly and you are asked to input a character name and ‘Clock in.’ Then two game modes are presented. You can play the main story, dubbed ‘The life of a chip’ where you character works through 12 chapters shepherding a hearing-aid chip from the R&D line into the hands of an end user. In this mode your blocky fab worker character will simulate dealing with equipment failures, process anomalies, and production progress emergencies. You might also have to file reports about operational errors. Apparently there are three endings to this 12-chapter game, depending on your progress and decisions.Another game mode is called ‘A day in the fab.’ Here you pick a factory location and role. For example, you can choose to be a Process Engineer. Your day started with the ETCH-03 semiconductor tool breaking, and “everyone is waiting for you to say what time it will be fixed.” Though this might sound like you’ve been thrown in at the deep end, if you pay attention to the handover from the previous shift, there should be clues to get you by. Technical terms are explained in the game so even those with no semiconductor industry experience should be able to ‘enjoy’ this escapade.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: I briefly tested the game in my browser, where it ran without issues. It didn’t take long to understand why some Taiwanese fab veterans felt this simulator was kind of stressful, or even “super scary.” It isn’t the kind of free-time escapism I’m looking for. items.titleZh: 网页版芯片晶圆厂工程游戏在台湾爆红
items.descriptionZh:
一款名为Fab24hr的3D网页游戏《半导体晶圆厂工人的一天》近日在台湾走红。该游戏由台湾团队开发，提供中文、英文和日文版本，玩家可在方块化等距视角的3D晶圆厂中扮演不同半导体工程师角色，体验晶圆厂工作日常。虽然画面较为基础，但台湾TVBS报道称，游戏的真实感引发不少晶圆厂员工共鸣，甚至有人将其形容为“恐怖游戏”或“监狱”，凸显半导体制造现场高压、紧绷的工作氛围。

游戏在Fab24hr网站打开后加载较快，玩家输入角色名并“打卡上班”后，可选择两种模式。其一是主线模式“芯片的一生”，共12章，玩家跟随一颗助听器芯片从研发线一路走到终端用户手中，期间需要处理设备故障、工艺异常、生产进度紧急状况，还可能提交操作失误报告。根据玩家进度和决策，游戏设有三种结局。另一模式为“晶圆厂的一天”，玩家可选择工厂地点和岗位，例如工艺工程师。游戏开始时，ETCH-03半导体设备发生故障，“所有人都在等你说明何时能修好”；玩家需留意上一班次的交接信息寻找线索。游戏内会解释技术术语，因此即使没有半导体行业经验也能理解并游玩。

从技术实现和设计看，Fab24hr以浏览器为运行平台，采用等距3D方块美术风格，将晶圆厂中的设备异常处理、工艺监控、交接班、生产紧急事件和报告流程转化为可交互任务，并通过分支叙事和角色选择增强模拟感。其创新点不在于高精度画面，而在于把半导体制造流程和岗位压力做成低门槛、可即玩的职业模拟器，并用真实术语和场景细节建立从业者共鸣。Tom's Hardware测试后表示，游戏在浏览器中运行无问题，也不难理解为何台湾晶圆厂资深员工会觉得这款模拟器压力很大甚至“超级可怕”——它显然不是轻松休闲的逃避式游戏。

该游戏的影响和应用场景主要在于半导体产业科普、公众认知、员工培训与招聘宣传等方向：一方面让外界更直观地理解晶圆厂工程师的日常工作与压力，另一方面也以“工作模拟”形式引发从业者对职场体验的讨论。不过，原文未提供具体性能参数或量化对比数据，更多体现为真实感、共鸣度和浏览器可玩性方面的反馈。

items.title: Official DLSS 5 running on unsupported games delivers up to 90% better performance than the leaked version
items.description: Nvidia's latest DLSS Neural Renderer, extracted from NBA 2K27 (again), is being tested on unsupported games and shows up to a 90% performance gain over the previous NR model.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A new version of DLSS 5 on NBA 2K27 was just released, and modders have already extracted it and are running it on unsupported games. Modders are comparing performance between the older and newer Neural Rendering (NR) model and found it up to 40% faster than the previous one.While many are still experimenting with leaked and first-release builds, Renan Maniero has already extracted the new 310.9.16.0 DLSS NR build, letting other modders use it in unsupported games and compare performance. Gaming Optimized on X compared the new NR model to the old one and found massive improvements of up to 90% in The Witcher 3 running DLSS 5 natively.Running a full NR model to modify your game's image is resource-intensive, just as LLMs require a lot of RAM; DLSS NR does, too. To improve performance, Nvidia made the AI model 24% smaller, using 20% less VRAM at 4K, and, according to Nvidia, processes its neural rendering workload up to 2x faster.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: I Uploaded a new Video about the new DLSS 5 Model that got released by Nvidia. The new model can be up to 90% Faster (The Witcher 3) compared to the older one, but the performance boost varies depending on the game tested. Video link below!! https://t.co/aohckywbty https://t.co/8dwSHMqIigOctober 16, 2026Typically, improving an AI model means increasing its parameters and size—in other words, giving it a bigger brain. However, because consumer GPUs have limited, non-upgradable VRAM, Nvidia can't improve by adding a bigger model; instead, the AI needs to become more efficient while reducing resource usage.These comparisons were much easier than switching back and forth between updates, since the latest version still includes the older model as a preset. The new DLL has two Neural Rendering presets: Preset A is the old model, and Preset B is the newer model. items.author: Jhet Borja
items.titleZh: 官方DLSS 5在不支持的游戏上运行，性能比泄露版高出90%。
items.descriptionZh:
英伟达新一代 DLSS 5 的神经渲染（Neural Rendering，NR）模型随《NBA 2K27》发布后，已被模组作者从游戏中提取，并在未获官方支持的游戏上运行。模组作者 Renan Maniero 提取了版本号为 310.9.16.0 的 DLSS NR 构建，供其他模组作者测试和对比。Gaming Optimized 在 X 上比较新旧 NR 模型后发现，新模型最高比旧模型快 40%；而在《巫师3》中通过原生 DLSS 5 运行时，提升最高可达 90%，但不同游戏的性能增幅差异明显。当前 DLSS 5 尚未广泛正式落地，模组社区实际上先行承担了性能验证和兼容性实验。

从技术原理看，DLSS NR 使用 AI 模型参与游戏图像的生成或修改，计算和显存开销较高，类似大语言模型需要大量内存。由于消费级 GPU 的显存容量固定且不可升级，英伟达不能简单通过增大模型参数来提升效果，而必须让模型更高效、更节省资源。新 NR 模型体积缩小了 24%，在 4K 下显存占用降低 20%，英伟达称其神经渲染工作负载处理速度最高提升 2 倍。也就是说，这一代优化的核心不是“更大的模型”，而是以更小、更高效的模型换取更低显存占用和更高推理性能。

对比方法也较为直接：最新 DLL 同时包含两个 NR 预设，Preset A 为旧模型，Preset B 为新模型，因此模组作者无需在版本之间反复切换即可进行 A/B 测试。DLSS 通过 RenoDX 或 OptiScaler 注入图形管线，并可调整 DLL 设置以获得不同结果；模组社区还修改了运行时，使其支持 RTX 20 系列显卡。性能提升幅度取决于具体游戏和设置，40% 和 90% 分别体现了一般对比与《巫师3》特定场景下的上限。

在影响和应用场景方面，英伟达官方计划将 DLSS 5 推向 RTX 40 系列，目前尚无正式登陆 RTX 30 或 RTX 20 系列的报告，但模组社区已先行实现非官方支持。这表明 DLSS 5 NR 的模型效率优化对 4K 游戏、显存受限的消费级显卡以及旧款 RTX 用户具有吸引力；同时，模组提取和注入也加速了社区对 DLSS 5 性能、兼容性和画质的独立验证。不过，非官方注入的稳定性、兼容性和实际画质表现仍需进一步观察，官方支持范围仍是决定其普及程度的关键变量。

items.title: MIT engineers build soft 3D shape-sensing skin for gaming and VR
items.description: MIT engineers embedded soft optical fibers in a silicone sheet that reconstructs its own 3D shape, aimed at gaming, VR, and physical therapy.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter MIT engineers have built a soft, wearable shape-sensing sheet with self-tracking movement that could be useful for controlling games, virtual reality, and physical therapy applications, reports MIT News. The technology, which leverages optical fibers to track the sheet’s own 3D shape, keeps its error below half a centimeter in lab tests. Qifan Yu, an MIT mechanical engineering graduate student on the team, put rigid-sensor designs at around 1 to 2 cm and called the result “at least on par with existing technologies.” The sheet also still works even when damaged, but the fibers remain thicker than ideal for garments.The news follows a paper, “Toward fully soft and multifunctional shape sensing via optical waveguide arrays,” recently published in Advanced Intelligent Systems. It details that the waveguides respond to bending in both directions, “bi-directional,” with the array laid out to discern shapes. Combined fiber responses mean fewer sensing elements are needed, and that can also improve damage resilience. The fibers respond to pressure, so they can sense external force, such as a press on the forearm in a physical therapy demo.Normally, a plain fiber, a transparent core inside a light-trapping cladding, will have less light reach the far end when bent; measuring the light output helps measure the bend. MIT’s changes here include using a flexible rubber core instead of glass, with black-dyed cladding. One side is roughened intentionally so that bending the fiber toward that side, or toward the opposite side, causes different amounts of light to be lost. This enables directional sensing.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Many such fibers are embedded in a silicone sheet, with an LED at one end of each fiber and a light sensor at the other. The sensing surface is fully soft, but the sheet doesn’t stretch as a whole. An external circuit board handles the data collection with an algorithm translating it into a full sheet and 3D shape. The 14 waveguides are each 160 mm long in two layers of seven, zig-zagged within a 16 x 16 x 0.5 cm silicone sheet. The electronics remain at the edge, including analog-to-digital converters that feed microcontrollers over I2C. The reconstruction runs in MATLAB about three times a second, a rate that includes sensor sampling, data logging, and plotting.To pick the layout, the team first simulated sheets with different waveguide arrangements: it generated the light output each fiber would give for a known shape, ran those readings through the reconstruction algorithm to estimate a 3D shape, and compared the estimate with the known one. One zig-zag spacing pattern had the closest fit. In simulations, between 3 and 20 waveguides per layer were used at angles of 0 to 35 degrees on six target shapes, with 10% added noise, over 30 trials each. The researchers discovered that angling the waveguides improved accuracy more than adding additional ones. You may like Meta Quest user vibe-codes 3D object throwing to 3D printer Researchers build a drone that navigates with physical whiskers to operate in dark, dusty or smoky places where cameras or GPS can fail Virginia Tech lab 3D prints a liquid metal composite to guide heat, boost thermal conductivity 40x Resilience was tested with a few fibers cut or disconnected, with the rest still able to reconstruct the overall shape. In simulation, the error stayed under 0.3 cm with up to three of the 14 waveguides disabled, and rose to about 1 cm or more from five on.A real sheet was then built on the pattern findings and put to the test with diagonal folding. For accuracy, the sheet was laid over three 3D-printed molds of known shapes, with the metric being the root-mean-square distance between real and reconstructed surfaces: 0.37, 0.28, and 0.45 cm. The force sensing does not have a calibrated force reading to tell how hard, and this detection runs separately from the shape mode. Each wearable demo was done by one author on their own body, with a simpler scaling method for wrist and elbow angles, because stretching at those joints throws off the shape algorithm, with no comment on comfort.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors (Image credit: Yu, Cao, Becker/Advanced Intelligent Systems/CC BY (edited))Yu said the setup targets fully soft sensing surfaces, so it’s potentially safer around people. Kaitlyn Becker, an MIT assistant professor of mechanical engineering and co-author, said the team hopes to build tools that help physical therapists track and quantify a patient’s progress over time, comparing sessions more precisely. Outside of this, the tech could also be used in virtual reality to mimic motion or could be used for the teleoperation of robots, or even just soft robots.As thinner fibers would have a wider applicability, the researchers plan to target a thinner sheet first. The 1 mm thick fibers of today could get as thin as tens of micrometers, thinner than a human hair. A higher fiber count could then make for smart garments. They also suggested future work could focus on a faster solver rather than the general-purpose one in MATLAB, more waveguide layers and narrower waveguides for better detail with thinner sheets, a separate sheet to gauge force and shape simultaneously, and stretchable electronics. items.titleZh: 麻省理工学院工程师打造用于游戏与VR的柔软3D形状传感皮肤
items.descriptionZh:
MIT工程师开发出一种柔软可穿戴的形状传感片，能够自我追踪运动，潜在用于游戏控制、虚拟现实和物理治疗。据MIT News报道，该技术利用光纤追踪传感片自身的3D形状，在实验室测试中误差保持在半厘米以下。参与该研究的MIT机械工程研究生Qifan Yu表示，刚性传感器设计的误差约为1至2厘米，因此新结果“至少与现有技术相当”。这种传感片即使在受损后仍能工作，但目前光纤对于理想服装而言仍偏粗。

相关论文《Toward fully soft and multifunctional shape sensing via optical waveguide arrays》最近发表在《Advanced Intelligent Systems》上。论文介绍，这些波导对两个方向的弯曲都有响应，即“双向”响应，并通过阵列布局来辨别形状。多根光纤响应的组合意味着所需传感元件更少，这也提高了损伤容错能力。光纤还能响应压力，因此可以感知外部作用力，例如在物理治疗演示中按压前臂。

在原理上，普通光纤由透明纤芯和陷光包层构成，弯曲时到达远端的光会减少，测量光输出即可测弯曲。MIT团队的改进包括用柔性橡胶芯替代玻璃芯，并使用黑色染色包层。光纤一侧被有意粗糙化，因此向该侧或相反侧弯曲会造成不同数量的光损失，从而实现方向传感。多根此类光纤嵌入硅胶片中，每根光纤一端接LED，另一端接光传感器。传感表面完全柔软，但整片材料并不会整体拉伸。外部电路板负责数据采集，算法将数据转换为整片传感片的3D形状。具体而言，14根波导每根长160毫米，分两层、每层7根，以锯齿状布置在16×16×0.5厘米的硅胶片内。电子器件位于边缘，包括通过I2C向微控制器提供数据的模数转换器。重建在MATLAB中运行，约每秒3次，这一速率包括传感器采样、数据记录和绘图。

为选择布局，团队首先模拟了不同波导排列的传感片：针对已知形状生成每根光纤的光输出，将这些读数输入重建算法估计3D形状，再与已知形状比较。一种锯齿间距模式拟合最好。模拟中，每层使用3至20根波导，角度为0至35度，针对六种目标形状并加入10%噪声，每种条件进行30次试验。研究人员发现，调整波导角度比增加波导数量更能提高精度。

在容错性测试中，几根光纤被切断或断开后，其余光纤仍能重建整体形状。模拟中，14根波导中最多3根失效时，误差保持在0.3厘米以下；从5根失效开始，误差升至约1厘米或更高。随后团队依据布局发现制作了真实传感片，并用对角线折叠进行测试。精度测试中，传感片覆盖在三个已知形状的3D打印模具上，指标为真实表面与重建表面之间的均方根距离，结果分别为0.37、0.28和0.45厘米。力传感目前没有校准的力读数来表明按压力度，而且该检测与形状模式分开运行。每个可穿戴演示均由一位作者在自己身体上完成；腕部和肘部角度采用更简单的缩放方法，因为这些关节处的拉伸会干扰形状算法，报道未评论舒适性。

Yu表示，该方案目标是实现完全柔软的传感表面，因此在与人体接触时可能更安全。MIT机械工程助理教授、共同作者Kaitlyn Becker说，团队希望构建工具，帮助物理治疗师追踪和量化患者随时间取得的进展，更精确地比较不同疗程。除此之外，该技术还可用于虚拟现实中模拟动作、机器人遥操作，甚至软体机器人。由于更细的光纤适用性更广，研究人员计划首先实现更薄的传感片：目前1毫米粗的光纤可望做到数十微米，比人类头发更细；更高的光纤数量则可进一步用于智能服装。未来工作还可能包括：采用比MATLAB通用求解器更快的求解器；增加波导层数并使用更窄波导，以便在更薄传感片中实现更好细节；使用独立传感片同时测量力和形状；以及发展可拉伸电子器件。

items.title: 300-plus local data center bans have only delayed just three US projects
items.description: SemiAnalysis mapped more than 300 local data center moratoriums against the US pipeline and found only three projects actually delayed.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter More than 300 local data center construction moratoriums haven’t had a massive impact on planned buildouts, with only three projects at about 2.3 out of 21 gigawatts (GW) of data centers in moratorium areas likely to be delayed, with a total of 38 GW projected to come online next year, SemiAnalysis shared on X. Per-project audits of the moratoriums indicate that they tend to miss the site, the permit, or the timeline.Moratoriums aren't killing the US datacenter buildout. Our analyst @mayabarkin finds only ~2.3 GW of ~21 GW in moratorium areas (excluding the TCEQ pause in Texas) is likely to be delayed, as cited in The Economist. For more, read her report in the SemiAnalysis newsletter👇️ https://t.co/N59qQFhDbJ https://t.co/MeHyR8hznUOctober 17, 2026The crux of the report is that, while everyone thinks the moratoriums are killing the U.S. buildout, its forecast has “barely moved over the last 12 months.” This forecast includes 38 GW of U.S. data center IT capacity in 2027, which is more than double that of 2026. Of that, 22 GW is under vertical construction, and the other 16 GW is mostly financed, with site work being done. The enacted local moratoriums cover about 20 GW with only about 1.5 GW of it delayed; New York’s pause adds 0.8 GW more. “We think moratoriums COULD delay the buildout, but they just aren’t yet at scale.”The firm defines a moratorium as a “temporary legal pause,” and almost always a “freeze on accepting new applications.” More than 400 local instruments are tracked across 17 states, the enacted ones including a few permanent zoning bans, as of September. Four states acted in under two months this summer: New York, Texas, Pennsylvania, and Oregon. To test each active restriction against the records of thousands of projects, the firm’s analysts worked alongside “an army of state-of-the-art research agents.”Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Several reasons are given for moratorium ineffectiveness, starting with the fact that they don’t revoke existing approvals. Short ones may expire before later projects need approval, and litigation or equipment lead times may already set the schedule. A moratorium moves the delivery date only if every condition holds, including that it reaches the parcel, is in force, overlaps the timeline, and covers the use in a way the project can’t work around. Capacity already under construction or fully permitted is also out of reach.For example, Michigan has 45 enacted moratoriums but effectively zero pipeline exposure, and a Google campus there sits on industrial land already zoned for data processing. The firm says SpaceX’s planned data center in Brownsville, Texas, is on land the city removed from its limits and thus out of reach of the city’s moratorium. For a moratorium that did work, a township adopted a pause before NorthPoint, in Pennsylvania, filed for its special exception, with local approval pushed to next year. The company is still pursuing it. You may like AI data center bans surge past 500 nationwide as local US politicians begin quickly blocking new developments Local opposition blocked $68 billion worth of data center projects in the second quarter of 2026 AI data center developers begin suing local jurisdictions behind bans and moratoriums The 2.3 GW figure is also incomplete, as it leaves out the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ) pause. Texas Gov. Greg Abbott told the TCEQ to issue no permits for data center projects. Law firm Bracewell says this applies whether a project is in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas’s (ERCOT) queue or not, and expects the pause to last until ERCOT finishes its review in mid-December. Pauses like the TCEQ’s, and how they play out, could impact buildout forecasts.The post quotes another by The Economist’s Archie Hall, from a trip that covers Michigan and Ohio, with the reporter stating that data center moratoriums are “much more bark than bite” for the time being. He puts the bigger risk at deterring newer projects, though he guesses that affects where data centers end up more than whether they get built. His impression is that politics also plays a role, and according to the firm’s poll in August, more Americans have a negative rather than positive impression of data centers.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsThe analysis concludes that moratoriums would need to be “materially more widespread and restrictive” to delay the buildout. On the firm’s weekly podcast last month, Jeremie Eliahou Ontiveros, one of the report’s authors, said the firm would be worried by a strict, state-level moratorium that blocked even off-grid projects, citing Texas as an example. New York Gov. Kathy Hochul, in addition to Abbott, also found ways to bypass their legislatures for pauses they control and can revoke. The next move to watch is the TCEQ’s compliance report to Abbott’s office, due Monday. items.titleZh: 300多项地方数据中心禁令仅推迟了三个美国项目
items.descriptionZh:
尽管美国各地已出台超过300项针对数据中心建设的暂停令或禁令，但SemiAnalysis的最新分析显示，这些地方性限制措施对整体建设计划的冲击远低于外界预期。在约21吉瓦（GW）位于禁令覆盖区域的数据中心容量中，预计仅有约2.3GW可能被延迟，其余项目基本不受影响。与此同时，该机构预测2027年美国数据中心IT容量将达到38GW，较2026年翻倍以上，其中22GW已进入垂直施工阶段，另外16GW已完成大部分融资并正在进行场地准备。SemiAnalysis分析师玛雅·巴尔金在报告中指出，过去12个月内其对美国数据中心建设的预测“几乎没有变动”，并直言“暂停令有可能延迟建设，但目前尚未形成规模效应”。

该机构将“暂停令”定义为一种临时性法律冻结，绝大多数情况下是“停止受理新的申请”。截至今年9月，研究团队在17个州追踪了400多项地方性法规工具，其中已生效的措施包括若干永久性分区禁令。仅今年夏天，纽约、得克萨斯、宾夕法尼亚和俄勒冈四州就在不到两个月内相继采取行动。为逐一核验每项限制措施对数千个项目的实际影响，分析团队动用了“一支由先进研究代理组成的大军”进行逐项目审计。

暂停令之所以效果有限，原因有多方面。首先，此类措施通常不撤销已获批的许可，已开工或完全获准的项目不在其管辖范围内。其次，短期暂停令可能在后续项目需要审批之前就已到期。此外，诉讼程序或设备交付周期本身已构成项目时间表的主要约束，暂停令只有在同时满足多个条件时才能真正改变交付日期：必须覆盖到具体地块、在项目审批窗口期内有效、与项目时间线重叠，且限制的使用类型无法被项目方绕开。

具体案例印证了这一判断。密歇根州虽已生效45项暂停令，但对在建项目管线的实际影响几乎为零，谷歌在该州的一个园区就位于已划定为数据处理用途的工业用地上。SpaceX计划在得州布朗斯维尔建设的数据中心，所在地块已被市政府从管辖范围内移除，因而城市暂停令鞭长莫及。宾夕法尼亚州一个乡镇的暂停令则确实发挥了作用——该镇在NorthPoint公司提交特殊例外申请之前就通过了暂停措施，导致地方审批被推迟至明年，但该公司仍在继续推进项目。

值得注意的是，2.3GW这一数字并未纳入得克萨斯州环境质量委员会（TCEQ）的暂停令。得州州长格雷格·阿博特已指示TCEQ停止为数据中心项目发放许可。律师事务所Bracewell指出，该禁令无论项目是否在得州电力可靠性委员会（ERCOT）的并网队列中均适用，预计将持续至ERCOT于12月中旬完成审查。此类由州级层面发起的暂停措施及其执行方式，可能对建设预测产生实质影响。

《经济学人》记者阿奇·霍尔在走访密歇根和俄亥俄后也持类似判断，认为数据中心暂停令目前“雷声大雨点小”。他认为更大的风险在于抑制新项目进入，但这更多影响数据中心的选址分布而非是否建设。政治因素同样不可忽视——SemiAnalysis今年8月的民调显示，对数据中心持负面看法的美国人多于持正面看法者。

分析结论认为，暂停令需要变得“范围更广、限制更严”才足以延迟整体建设进度。报告作者之一杰雷米·埃利亚胡·翁蒂韦罗斯在该机构的播客中表示，真正令人担忧的是州级层面严格到连离网项目都阻止的暂停令，并以得州为例。纽约州州长凯西·霍楚尔与阿博特一样，均找到了绕过立法机构、由行政层面掌控且可随时撤销的暂停手段。下一个值得关注的节点是TCEQ向州长办公室提交的合规报告，截止日期为周一。

items.title: RTX Spark Ignites Global Celebration as New Windows PCs Arrive
items.description: NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops are now available, bringing NVIDIA Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 128GB of unified memory and the full NVIDIA AI platform to slim, premium Windows PCs.  Starting at $2,399, laptops from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI bring powerful local AI, content creation and gaming capabilities to a portable device, with […]
items.content: NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops are now available, bringing NVIDIA Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 128GB of unified memory and the full NVIDIA AI platform to slim, premium Windows PCs. Starting at $2,399, laptops from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI bring powerful local AI, content creation and gaming capabilities to a portable device, with additional systems on the way. NVIDIA celebrated the launch with events around the world, including one in Berlin, where NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang made a surprise appearance. A New Generation of Windows PCs Has Arrived RTX Spark brings decades of NVIDIA accelerated computing innovation into a single superchip, combining an NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU and NVIDIA Grace CPU with up to 1 petaflop of AI compute and up to 128GB of unified memory. Read more in the press release. RTX Spark Launch Celebrations Light Up Berlin The arrival of RTX Spark brought fans, creators and PC enthusiasts together in Berlin during the Festival of Lights, an annual autumn art festival that transforms the German capital’s most famous landmarks, streets and squares into glowing canvases. This year, the festival featured RTX Spark-themed lighting on the Berlin TV Tower. Berlin sparked something special, indeed. Fans gathered hours ahead in anticipation for the launch celebration at XPERION, the gaming venue inside Saturn at Alexanderplatz, where attendees got hands-on with RTX Spark laptops from leading PC makers, exploring the latest gaming experiences, content-creation workflows and local AI capabilities. Even this Geralt cosplayer waited to get his hands on RTX Spark. The celebration included a special appearance by Huang, who greeted an enthusiastic crowd, passed out popcorn and posed for selfies. He also gave out five personally signed RTX Spark laptops. You get a signed RTX Spark. You get a signed RTX Spark. Berlin held one of six RTX Spark retail launch celebrations worldwide. From San Francisco to Seoul: How the World Welcomed RTX Spark A massive crowd gathered at the JD MALL Shuangjing Store in Beijing to celebrate the highly anticipated launch, enjoying a night of innovation and community connection. Crowds gathered to demo RTX Spark at the Beijing RTX Spark launch party. Attendees at Vatan Bilgisayar Topkapı in Istanbul experienced a lively event filled with interactive demonstrations and specialized programming led by local creators. Attendees witnessed local celebrities speak at the RTX Spark launch party in Istanbul. Seoul’s COEX East Lobby transformed into a bustling hub of creativity, hosting an eager crowd for engaging hands-on demos and captivating evening sessions dedicated to gaming and AI. Hands-on demos at the RTX Spark launch party in Seoul. Tech enthusiasts in San Francisco visited the local Best Buy store for an unforgettable morning of hands-on RTX Spark demos, fireside chats with local founders and a special appearance by tech influencer iJustine. Lines were long but lively at the San Francisco RTX Spark launch party. The energy at Muse Garden in Taipei was electric as the local AI community came together for a vibrant evening of music, engaging discussions and incredible product showcases. Incredible atmosphere at the Taipei RTX Spark launch party. Developers and AI enthusiasts can explore NVIDIA-tested recipes, playbooks and resources for running local AI on RTX Spark. Follow NVIDIA RTX Spark on X, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook — and stay informed by subscribing to the NVIDIA Local AI newsletter. Follow NVIDIA Workstation on LinkedIn and X. items.titleZh: RTX Spark点燃全球庆典，全新Windows PC上市
items.descriptionZh:
NVIDIA 宣布 RTX Spark 笔记本电脑正式上市，将 Blackwell RTX 显卡、最高 128GB 统一内存以及完整的 NVIDIA AI 平台带入纤薄的高端 Windows PC。新品起售价为 2,399 美元，首批来自 ASUS、Dell、HP、Lenovo、Microsoft 和 MSI，后续还会有更多机型推出。NVIDIA 称，RTX Spark 面向本地 AI、内容创作和游戏等场景，旨在让高性能 AI 能力从云端延伸到便携设备。

从技术架构看，RTX Spark 将 NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU 与 NVIDIA Grace CPU 集成到单一“超级芯片”中，最高提供 1 petaflop AI 算力和 128GB 统一内存。统一内存的核心意义在于让 CPU、GPU 共享同一内存池，减少传统架构中频繁的数据拷贝和内存分区限制，从而更高效地运行大型本地 AI 模型、复杂创作工作流和图形负载，并改善能效与响应速度。NVIDIA 表示，这一设计把其数十年加速计算创新浓缩到一台 PC 中，使本地 AI 推理、生成式 AI 应用、内容制作和游戏可在更纤薄的设备上完成。

价格方面，RTX Spark 笔记本起售价 2,399 美元，定位高端 premium Windows PC。其卖点不只是传统显卡性能，而是“AI PC”形态：通过最高 128GB 统一内存和最高 1 petaflop AI 算力，支持更大参数模型和更复杂的本地 AI 任务，同时兼顾游戏与创意生产。NVIDIA 还面向开发者和 AI 爱好者提供经过 NVIDIA 测试的 recipes、playbooks 和资源，帮助用户在 RTX Spark 上运行本地 AI。

NVIDIA 在全球多地举办 RTX Spark 上市庆祝活动。柏林站结合“灯光节”，在柏林电视塔呈现 RTX Spark 主题灯光；粉丝在 Alexanderplatz 的 Saturn 内 XPERION 游戏场馆提前数小时排队，体验来自各大 PC 厂商的 RTX Spark 笔记本、游戏体验、内容创作工作流和本地 AI 能力。NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO 黄仁勋意外现身，与人群互动、分发爆米花、合影自拍，并送出五台亲笔签名 RTX Spark 笔记本。

柏林是全球六场 RTX Spark 零售上市庆祝活动之一。其他活动包括：北京 JD MALL 双井店的大型发布活动；伊斯坦布尔 Vatan Bilgisayar Topkapı 的互动演示和本地创作者编程活动；首尔 COEX 东大厅的游戏与 AI 动手演示及晚间专场；旧金山 Best Buy 的清晨体验、与本地创始人的炉边谈话以及科技网红 iJustine 的特别亮相；台北 Muse Garden 面向本地 AI 社区的音乐、讨论和产品展示。整体来看，RTX Spark 的发布标志着 NVIDIA 将其 GPU、CPU 和 AI 软件生态进一步整合到 Windows PC 形态中，瞄准高端创作者、开发者和游戏玩家，并推动本地 AI 从概念走向可购买、可体验的终端设备。

history.title: Nvidia RTX 5090 shipment worth $470,000 goes missing in Brazilian airport
history.description: Brazilian electronics and IT distributor Oderço claims that two pallets of Zotac RTX 5090 GPUs have arrived at the airport but has since completely disappeared.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 13 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A Brazilian electronics and IT distributor, Oderço, has gone on Instagram after failing to find answers about a missing shipment of RTX 5090 GPUs worth around $470,000 or R$2,500,000. According to its Instagram post [machine translated], the company has never faced an experience like this in its 38-year history. It was expecting two pallets of Zotac RTX 5090 GPUs at Guarulhos International Airport in São Paulo, which supposedly arrived there but then disappeared. The company has not provided any details, like the shipment’s arrival date or any tracking numbers, but claims that there hasn’t been any official response regarding its shipment inquiries. Because of this, the company went on the social media platform pleading for answers.A post shared by Oderço (@odercodistribuidora)RTX 5090s are currently in short supply across the world, with the top-tier card disappearing from online retailers in the middle of September. There have been rumors that Nvidia has ceased production of the GPU to focus on more expensive professional AI cards, although it insists otherwise. Still, it doesn’t help that the flagship GPU is marked “not carried” in Micro Center’s online retail store, making it insanely difficult to find one of the best gaming GPUs you can buy today.We don’t have any idea how many GPUs are missing, as the distributor only mentioned two pallets’ worth of RTX 5090s. A Zotac Gaming GeForce RTX 5090, which goes for around $8,000 on Amazon presently, is listed at R$33,999.99 on a Brazilian online retailer Promotech. This means that the company is missing 63 GPUs at the minimum, although this is likely going to be so much more considering that the $R2,500,000 amount the company said is its acquisition cost, not the retail price that it’s expected to go for.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: We’ve seen various scams where retail customers lose their GPU shipments on the way to their home or delivery address, as well as unscrupulous buyers stripping off the GPU core and memory modules from an RTX 5090 and then shipping it back to the seller. This also isn’t the first instance that a shipment of high-value graphics cards has been stolen — one brazen crew has even rammed security escorts to hijack an AI hardware shipment, while another group stole two trailers marked with the Nvidia logo, only to find that it contained sand. history.titleZh: 价值47万美元的英伟达RTX 5090货件在巴西机场失踪
history.descriptionZh:
巴西电子与IT分销商Oderço近日在Instagram公开求助，原因是其一批发往圣保罗瓜鲁柳斯国际机场的Zotac GeForce RTX 5090显卡货物失踪。公司称，这批货物为两托盘RTX 5090，价值约47万美元（约250万雷亚尔），但货物据称抵达机场后却不知所踪。Oderço表示，在其38年经营历史中从未遇到类似情况，且公司就货物查询始终未获得正式回应，因此选择通过社交媒体公开寻求答案。原文未披露货物具体到达日期、追踪编号或承运细节，也未说明失踪显卡的确切数量；按其披露的采购成本和巴西零售商Promotech标价33,999.99雷亚尔/块推算，原文估计至少涉及63块GPU，但由于250万雷亚尔是采购成本而非零售价，实际数量可能更多。

这一事件发生在RTX 5090全球严重缺货的背景下。作为英伟达当前旗舰级游戏GPU，RTX 5090自9月中旬起从多家在线零售商处消失，市场供应极为紧张。原文提到，有传闻称英伟达已停止该GPU生产，以将产能转向价格更高的专业AI卡，但英伟达否认这一说法。与此同时，美国Micro Center线上商店将这款旗舰GPU标记为“not carried”，进一步加剧了消费者购买难度。价格方面，Zotac Gaming GeForce RTX 5090在亚马逊上目前售价约8,000美元，而在巴西在线零售商Promotech的标价为33,999.99雷亚尔。高售价、稀缺供应和强劲需求共同抬高了该产品的黑市价值和运输风险。

从技术影响和应用场景看，RTX 5090属于高端消费级GPU，主要面向顶级游戏、内容创作和高性能计算需求；在当前AI算力需求旺盛、专业AI加速卡价格更高的市场环境下，旗舰游戏GPU的短缺也会波及工作站和小型AI部署等场景。原文并未披露RTX 5090的具体技术参数或产品创新点，新闻核心是高端GPU供应链中的物流失窃与短缺问题。此次案件并非孤立事件：原文回顾了多类GPU相关犯罪，包括零售客户在配送途中丢失显卡、买家拆走RTX 5090的GPU核心和显存后把空卡退回卖家，以及犯罪团伙驾车冲撞安保押运车辆劫持AI硬件运输、偷走带有英伟达标志的拖车却发现里面装的是沙子等案例。这些事件表明，高价值GPU已成为有组织犯罪的目标，分销商和零售商需要加强运输安保、保险、全程追踪、交接验证和防拆封措施，否则缺货与高价将进一步刺激盗窃和欺诈风险。对Oderço而言，此次事件不仅带来约47万美元的直接财务损失，也可能影响其供货能力和渠道信誉；对终端市场而言，则可能进一步加剧RTX 5090的短缺和价格波动。

history.title: Web-based chip fab engineering game goes viral in Taiwan
history.description: A new 3D web game where you live 'A Day in the Life of a Semiconductor Wafer Factory Worker' has gone viral in Taiwan, where it was developed.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A new 3D web game where you live "A Day in the Life of a Semiconductor Wafer Factory Worker" has gone viral in Taiwan, where it was developed. Available in Chinese, English, and Japanese, Fab24hr is a work simulator where you play one of several semiconductor engineer roles in a blocky isometric 3D factory. Though the graphics might look basic, Taiwan’s TVBS news says that the game is so realistic that it resonates with fab workers but not always in a good way – some have likened it to "a horror game" or "prison" [machine translation]. Image 1 of 5 (Image credit: Fab24hr) (Image credit: Fab24hr) (Image credit: Fab24hr) (Image credit: Fab24hr) (Image credit: Fab24hr) Image 1 of 5 View Original Image 2 of 5 View Original Image 3 of 5 View Original Image 4 of 5 View Original Image 5 of 5 View Original If you head over to the Fab24hr site, the game UI loads pretty quickly and you are asked to input a character name and ‘Clock in.’ Then two game modes are presented. You can play the main story, dubbed ‘The life of a chip’ where you character works through 12 chapters shepherding a hearing-aid chip from the R&D line into the hands of an end user. In this mode your blocky fab worker character will simulate dealing with equipment failures, process anomalies, and production progress emergencies. You might also have to file reports about operational errors. Apparently there are three endings to this 12-chapter game, depending on your progress and decisions.Another game mode is called ‘A day in the fab.’ Here you pick a factory location and role. For example, you can choose to be a Process Engineer. Your day started with the ETCH-03 semiconductor tool breaking, and “everyone is waiting for you to say what time it will be fixed.” Though this might sound like you’ve been thrown in at the deep end, if you pay attention to the handover from the previous shift, there should be clues to get you by. Technical terms are explained in the game so even those with no semiconductor industry experience should be able to ‘enjoy’ this escapade.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: I briefly tested the game in my browser, where it ran without issues. It didn’t take long to understand why some Taiwanese fab veterans felt this simulator was kind of stressful, or even “super scary.” It isn’t the kind of free-time escapism I’m looking for. history.author: Mark Tyson
history.titleZh: 网页版芯片晶圆厂工程游戏在台湾爆红
history.descriptionZh:
一款名为Fab24hr的3D网页游戏《半导体晶圆厂工人的一天》近日在台湾走红。该游戏由台湾团队开发，提供中文、英文和日文版本，玩家可在方块化等距视角的3D晶圆厂中扮演不同半导体工程师角色，体验晶圆厂工作日常。虽然画面较为基础，但台湾TVBS报道称，游戏的真实感引发不少晶圆厂员工共鸣，甚至有人将其形容为“恐怖游戏”或“监狱”，凸显半导体制造现场高压、紧绷的工作氛围。

游戏在Fab24hr网站打开后加载较快，玩家输入角色名并“打卡上班”后，可选择两种模式。其一是主线模式“芯片的一生”，共12章，玩家跟随一颗助听器芯片从研发线一路走到终端用户手中，期间需要处理设备故障、工艺异常、生产进度紧急状况，还可能提交操作失误报告。根据玩家进度和决策，游戏设有三种结局。另一模式为“晶圆厂的一天”，玩家可选择工厂地点和岗位，例如工艺工程师。游戏开始时，ETCH-03半导体设备发生故障，“所有人都在等你说明何时能修好”；玩家需留意上一班次的交接信息寻找线索。游戏内会解释技术术语，因此即使没有半导体行业经验也能理解并游玩。

从技术实现和设计看，Fab24hr以浏览器为运行平台，采用等距3D方块美术风格，将晶圆厂中的设备异常处理、工艺监控、交接班、生产紧急事件和报告流程转化为可交互任务，并通过分支叙事和角色选择增强模拟感。其创新点不在于高精度画面，而在于把半导体制造流程和岗位压力做成低门槛、可即玩的职业模拟器，并用真实术语和场景细节建立从业者共鸣。Tom's Hardware测试后表示，游戏在浏览器中运行无问题，也不难理解为何台湾晶圆厂资深员工会觉得这款模拟器压力很大甚至“超级可怕”——它显然不是轻松休闲的逃避式游戏。

该游戏的影响和应用场景主要在于半导体产业科普、公众认知、员工培训与招聘宣传等方向：一方面让外界更直观地理解晶圆厂工程师的日常工作与压力，另一方面也以“工作模拟”形式引发从业者对职场体验的讨论。不过，原文未提供具体性能参数或量化对比数据，更多体现为真实感、共鸣度和浏览器可玩性方面的反馈。

history.title: Official DLSS 5 running on unsupported games delivers up to 90% better performance than the leaked version
history.description: Nvidia's latest DLSS Neural Renderer, extracted from NBA 2K27 (again), is being tested on unsupported games and shows up to a 90% performance gain over the previous NR model.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A new version of DLSS 5 on NBA 2K27 was just released, and modders have already extracted it and are running it on unsupported games. Modders are comparing performance between the older and newer Neural Rendering (NR) model and found it up to 40% faster than the previous one.While many are still experimenting with leaked and first-release builds, Renan Maniero has already extracted the new 310.9.16.0 DLSS NR build, letting other modders use it in unsupported games and compare performance. Gaming Optimized on X compared the new NR model to the old one and found massive improvements of up to 90% in The Witcher 3 running DLSS 5 natively.Running a full NR model to modify your game's image is resource-intensive, just as LLMs require a lot of RAM; DLSS NR does, too. To improve performance, Nvidia made the AI model 24% smaller, using 20% less VRAM at 4K, and, according to Nvidia, processes its neural rendering workload up to 2x faster.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: I Uploaded a new Video about the new DLSS 5 Model that got released by Nvidia. The new model can be up to 90% Faster (The Witcher 3) compared to the older one, but the performance boost varies depending on the game tested. Video link below!! https://t.co/aohckywbty https://t.co/8dwSHMqIigOctober 16, 2026Typically, improving an AI model means increasing its parameters and size—in other words, giving it a bigger brain. However, because consumer GPUs have limited, non-upgradable VRAM, Nvidia can't improve by adding a bigger model; instead, the AI needs to become more efficient while reducing resource usage.These comparisons were much easier than switching back and forth between updates, since the latest version still includes the older model as a preset. The new DLL has two Neural Rendering presets: Preset A is the old model, and Preset B is the newer model. history.author: Jhet Borja
history.titleZh: 官方DLSS 5在不支持的游戏上运行，性能比泄露版高出90%。
history.descriptionZh:
英伟达新一代 DLSS 5 的神经渲染（Neural Rendering，NR）模型随《NBA 2K27》发布后，已被模组作者从游戏中提取，并在未获官方支持的游戏上运行。模组作者 Renan Maniero 提取了版本号为 310.9.16.0 的 DLSS NR 构建，供其他模组作者测试和对比。Gaming Optimized 在 X 上比较新旧 NR 模型后发现，新模型最高比旧模型快 40%；而在《巫师3》中通过原生 DLSS 5 运行时，提升最高可达 90%，但不同游戏的性能增幅差异明显。当前 DLSS 5 尚未广泛正式落地，模组社区实际上先行承担了性能验证和兼容性实验。

从技术原理看，DLSS NR 使用 AI 模型参与游戏图像的生成或修改，计算和显存开销较高，类似大语言模型需要大量内存。由于消费级 GPU 的显存容量固定且不可升级，英伟达不能简单通过增大模型参数来提升效果，而必须让模型更高效、更节省资源。新 NR 模型体积缩小了 24%，在 4K 下显存占用降低 20%，英伟达称其神经渲染工作负载处理速度最高提升 2 倍。也就是说，这一代优化的核心不是“更大的模型”，而是以更小、更高效的模型换取更低显存占用和更高推理性能。

对比方法也较为直接：最新 DLL 同时包含两个 NR 预设，Preset A 为旧模型，Preset B 为新模型，因此模组作者无需在版本之间反复切换即可进行 A/B 测试。DLSS 通过 RenoDX 或 OptiScaler 注入图形管线，并可调整 DLL 设置以获得不同结果；模组社区还修改了运行时，使其支持 RTX 20 系列显卡。性能提升幅度取决于具体游戏和设置，40% 和 90% 分别体现了一般对比与《巫师3》特定场景下的上限。

在影响和应用场景方面，英伟达官方计划将 DLSS 5 推向 RTX 40 系列，目前尚无正式登陆 RTX 30 或 RTX 20 系列的报告，但模组社区已先行实现非官方支持。这表明 DLSS 5 NR 的模型效率优化对 4K 游戏、显存受限的消费级显卡以及旧款 RTX 用户具有吸引力；同时，模组提取和注入也加速了社区对 DLSS 5 性能、兼容性和画质的独立验证。不过，非官方注入的稳定性、兼容性和实际画质表现仍需进一步观察，官方支持范围仍是决定其普及程度的关键变量。

history.title: MIT engineers build soft 3D shape-sensing skin for gaming and VR
history.description: MIT engineers embedded soft optical fibers in a silicone sheet that reconstructs its own 3D shape, aimed at gaming, VR, and physical therapy.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter MIT engineers have built a soft, wearable shape-sensing sheet with self-tracking movement that could be useful for controlling games, virtual reality, and physical therapy applications, reports MIT News. The technology, which leverages optical fibers to track the sheet’s own 3D shape, keeps its error below half a centimeter in lab tests. Qifan Yu, an MIT mechanical engineering graduate student on the team, put rigid-sensor designs at around 1 to 2 cm and called the result “at least on par with existing technologies.” The sheet also still works even when damaged, but the fibers remain thicker than ideal for garments.The news follows a paper, “Toward fully soft and multifunctional shape sensing via optical waveguide arrays,” recently published in Advanced Intelligent Systems. It details that the waveguides respond to bending in both directions, “bi-directional,” with the array laid out to discern shapes. Combined fiber responses mean fewer sensing elements are needed, and that can also improve damage resilience. The fibers respond to pressure, so they can sense external force, such as a press on the forearm in a physical therapy demo.Normally, a plain fiber, a transparent core inside a light-trapping cladding, will have less light reach the far end when bent; measuring the light output helps measure the bend. MIT’s changes here include using a flexible rubber core instead of glass, with black-dyed cladding. One side is roughened intentionally so that bending the fiber toward that side, or toward the opposite side, causes different amounts of light to be lost. This enables directional sensing.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Many such fibers are embedded in a silicone sheet, with an LED at one end of each fiber and a light sensor at the other. The sensing surface is fully soft, but the sheet doesn’t stretch as a whole. An external circuit board handles the data collection with an algorithm translating it into a full sheet and 3D shape. The 14 waveguides are each 160 mm long in two layers of seven, zig-zagged within a 16 x 16 x 0.5 cm silicone sheet. The electronics remain at the edge, including analog-to-digital converters that feed microcontrollers over I2C. The reconstruction runs in MATLAB about three times a second, a rate that includes sensor sampling, data logging, and plotting.To pick the layout, the team first simulated sheets with different waveguide arrangements: it generated the light output each fiber would give for a known shape, ran those readings through the reconstruction algorithm to estimate a 3D shape, and compared the estimate with the known one. One zig-zag spacing pattern had the closest fit. In simulations, between 3 and 20 waveguides per layer were used at angles of 0 to 35 degrees on six target shapes, with 10% added noise, over 30 trials each. The researchers discovered that angling the waveguides improved accuracy more than adding additional ones. You may like Meta Quest user vibe-codes 3D object throwing to 3D printer Researchers build a drone that navigates with physical whiskers to operate in dark, dusty or smoky places where cameras or GPS can fail Virginia Tech lab 3D prints a liquid metal composite to guide heat, boost thermal conductivity 40x Resilience was tested with a few fibers cut or disconnected, with the rest still able to reconstruct the overall shape. In simulation, the error stayed under 0.3 cm with up to three of the 14 waveguides disabled, and rose to about 1 cm or more from five on.A real sheet was then built on the pattern findings and put to the test with diagonal folding. For accuracy, the sheet was laid over three 3D-printed molds of known shapes, with the metric being the root-mean-square distance between real and reconstructed surfaces: 0.37, 0.28, and 0.45 cm. The force sensing does not have a calibrated force reading to tell how hard, and this detection runs separately from the shape mode. Each wearable demo was done by one author on their own body, with a simpler scaling method for wrist and elbow angles, because stretching at those joints throws off the shape algorithm, with no comment on comfort.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors (Image credit: Yu, Cao, Becker/Advanced Intelligent Systems/CC BY (edited))Yu said the setup targets fully soft sensing surfaces, so it’s potentially safer around people. Kaitlyn Becker, an MIT assistant professor of mechanical engineering and co-author, said the team hopes to build tools that help physical therapists track and quantify a patient’s progress over time, comparing sessions more precisely. Outside of this, the tech could also be used in virtual reality to mimic motion or could be used for the teleoperation of robots, or even just soft robots.As thinner fibers would have a wider applicability, the researchers plan to target a thinner sheet first. The 1 mm thick fibers of today could get as thin as tens of micrometers, thinner than a human hair. A higher fiber count could then make for smart garments. They also suggested future work could focus on a faster solver rather than the general-purpose one in MATLAB, more waveguide layers and narrower waveguides for better detail with thinner sheets, a separate sheet to gauge force and shape simultaneously, and stretchable electronics. history.author: Shane Downing
history.titleZh: 麻省理工学院工程师打造用于游戏与VR的柔软3D形状传感皮肤
history.descriptionZh:
MIT工程师开发出一种柔软可穿戴的形状传感片，能够自我追踪运动，潜在用于游戏控制、虚拟现实和物理治疗。据MIT News报道，该技术利用光纤追踪传感片自身的3D形状，在实验室测试中误差保持在半厘米以下。参与该研究的MIT机械工程研究生Qifan Yu表示，刚性传感器设计的误差约为1至2厘米，因此新结果“至少与现有技术相当”。这种传感片即使在受损后仍能工作，但目前光纤对于理想服装而言仍偏粗。

相关论文《Toward fully soft and multifunctional shape sensing via optical waveguide arrays》最近发表在《Advanced Intelligent Systems》上。论文介绍，这些波导对两个方向的弯曲都有响应，即“双向”响应，并通过阵列布局来辨别形状。多根光纤响应的组合意味着所需传感元件更少，这也提高了损伤容错能力。光纤还能响应压力，因此可以感知外部作用力，例如在物理治疗演示中按压前臂。

在原理上，普通光纤由透明纤芯和陷光包层构成，弯曲时到达远端的光会减少，测量光输出即可测弯曲。MIT团队的改进包括用柔性橡胶芯替代玻璃芯，并使用黑色染色包层。光纤一侧被有意粗糙化，因此向该侧或相反侧弯曲会造成不同数量的光损失，从而实现方向传感。多根此类光纤嵌入硅胶片中，每根光纤一端接LED，另一端接光传感器。传感表面完全柔软，但整片材料并不会整体拉伸。外部电路板负责数据采集，算法将数据转换为整片传感片的3D形状。具体而言，14根波导每根长160毫米，分两层、每层7根，以锯齿状布置在16×16×0.5厘米的硅胶片内。电子器件位于边缘，包括通过I2C向微控制器提供数据的模数转换器。重建在MATLAB中运行，约每秒3次，这一速率包括传感器采样、数据记录和绘图。

为选择布局，团队首先模拟了不同波导排列的传感片：针对已知形状生成每根光纤的光输出，将这些读数输入重建算法估计3D形状，再与已知形状比较。一种锯齿间距模式拟合最好。模拟中，每层使用3至20根波导，角度为0至35度，针对六种目标形状并加入10%噪声，每种条件进行30次试验。研究人员发现，调整波导角度比增加波导数量更能提高精度。

在容错性测试中，几根光纤被切断或断开后，其余光纤仍能重建整体形状。模拟中，14根波导中最多3根失效时，误差保持在0.3厘米以下；从5根失效开始，误差升至约1厘米或更高。随后团队依据布局发现制作了真实传感片，并用对角线折叠进行测试。精度测试中，传感片覆盖在三个已知形状的3D打印模具上，指标为真实表面与重建表面之间的均方根距离，结果分别为0.37、0.28和0.45厘米。力传感目前没有校准的力读数来表明按压力度，而且该检测与形状模式分开运行。每个可穿戴演示均由一位作者在自己身体上完成；腕部和肘部角度采用更简单的缩放方法，因为这些关节处的拉伸会干扰形状算法，报道未评论舒适性。

Yu表示，该方案目标是实现完全柔软的传感表面，因此在与人体接触时可能更安全。MIT机械工程助理教授、共同作者Kaitlyn Becker说，团队希望构建工具，帮助物理治疗师追踪和量化患者随时间取得的进展，更精确地比较不同疗程。除此之外，该技术还可用于虚拟现实中模拟动作、机器人遥操作，甚至软体机器人。由于更细的光纤适用性更广，研究人员计划首先实现更薄的传感片：目前1毫米粗的光纤可望做到数十微米，比人类头发更细；更高的光纤数量则可进一步用于智能服装。未来工作还可能包括：采用比MATLAB通用求解器更快的求解器；增加波导层数并使用更窄波导，以便在更薄传感片中实现更好细节；使用独立传感片同时测量力和形状；以及发展可拉伸电子器件。

history.title: 300-plus local data center bans have only delayed just three US projects
history.description: SemiAnalysis mapped more than 300 local data center moratoriums against the US pipeline and found only three projects actually delayed.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter More than 300 local data center construction moratoriums haven’t had a massive impact on planned buildouts, with only three projects at about 2.3 out of 21 gigawatts (GW) of data centers in moratorium areas likely to be delayed, with a total of 38 GW projected to come online next year, SemiAnalysis shared on X. Per-project audits of the moratoriums indicate that they tend to miss the site, the permit, or the timeline.Moratoriums aren't killing the US datacenter buildout. Our analyst @mayabarkin finds only ~2.3 GW of ~21 GW in moratorium areas (excluding the TCEQ pause in Texas) is likely to be delayed, as cited in The Economist. For more, read her report in the SemiAnalysis newsletter👇️ https://t.co/N59qQFhDbJ https://t.co/MeHyR8hznUOctober 17, 2026The crux of the report is that, while everyone thinks the moratoriums are killing the U.S. buildout, its forecast has “barely moved over the last 12 months.” This forecast includes 38 GW of U.S. data center IT capacity in 2027, which is more than double that of 2026. Of that, 22 GW is under vertical construction, and the other 16 GW is mostly financed, with site work being done. The enacted local moratoriums cover about 20 GW with only about 1.5 GW of it delayed; New York’s pause adds 0.8 GW more. “We think moratoriums COULD delay the buildout, but they just aren’t yet at scale.”The firm defines a moratorium as a “temporary legal pause,” and almost always a “freeze on accepting new applications.” More than 400 local instruments are tracked across 17 states, the enacted ones including a few permanent zoning bans, as of September. Four states acted in under two months this summer: New York, Texas, Pennsylvania, and Oregon. To test each active restriction against the records of thousands of projects, the firm’s analysts worked alongside “an army of state-of-the-art research agents.”Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Several reasons are given for moratorium ineffectiveness, starting with the fact that they don’t revoke existing approvals. Short ones may expire before later projects need approval, and litigation or equipment lead times may already set the schedule. A moratorium moves the delivery date only if every condition holds, including that it reaches the parcel, is in force, overlaps the timeline, and covers the use in a way the project can’t work around. Capacity already under construction or fully permitted is also out of reach.For example, Michigan has 45 enacted moratoriums but effectively zero pipeline exposure, and a Google campus there sits on industrial land already zoned for data processing. The firm says SpaceX’s planned data center in Brownsville, Texas, is on land the city removed from its limits and thus out of reach of the city’s moratorium. For a moratorium that did work, a township adopted a pause before NorthPoint, in Pennsylvania, filed for its special exception, with local approval pushed to next year. The company is still pursuing it. You may like AI data center bans surge past 500 nationwide as local US politicians begin quickly blocking new developments Local opposition blocked $68 billion worth of data center projects in the second quarter of 2026 AI data center developers begin suing local jurisdictions behind bans and moratoriums The 2.3 GW figure is also incomplete, as it leaves out the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ) pause. Texas Gov. Greg Abbott told the TCEQ to issue no permits for data center projects. Law firm Bracewell says this applies whether a project is in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas’s (ERCOT) queue or not, and expects the pause to last until ERCOT finishes its review in mid-December. Pauses like the TCEQ’s, and how they play out, could impact buildout forecasts.The post quotes another by The Economist’s Archie Hall, from a trip that covers Michigan and Ohio, with the reporter stating that data center moratoriums are “much more bark than bite” for the time being. He puts the bigger risk at deterring newer projects, though he guesses that affects where data centers end up more than whether they get built. His impression is that politics also plays a role, and according to the firm’s poll in August, more Americans have a negative rather than positive impression of data centers.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsThe analysis concludes that moratoriums would need to be “materially more widespread and restrictive” to delay the buildout. On the firm’s weekly podcast last month, Jeremie Eliahou Ontiveros, one of the report’s authors, said the firm would be worried by a strict, state-level moratorium that blocked even off-grid projects, citing Texas as an example. New York Gov. Kathy Hochul, in addition to Abbott, also found ways to bypass their legislatures for pauses they control and can revoke. The next move to watch is the TCEQ’s compliance report to Abbott’s office, due Monday. history.titleZh: 300多项地方数据中心禁令仅推迟了三个美国项目
history.descriptionZh:
尽管美国各地已出台超过300项针对数据中心建设的暂停令或禁令，但SemiAnalysis的最新分析显示，这些地方性限制措施对整体建设计划的冲击远低于外界预期。在约21吉瓦（GW）位于禁令覆盖区域的数据中心容量中，预计仅有约2.3GW可能被延迟，其余项目基本不受影响。与此同时，该机构预测2027年美国数据中心IT容量将达到38GW，较2026年翻倍以上，其中22GW已进入垂直施工阶段，另外16GW已完成大部分融资并正在进行场地准备。SemiAnalysis分析师玛雅·巴尔金在报告中指出，过去12个月内其对美国数据中心建设的预测“几乎没有变动”，并直言“暂停令有可能延迟建设，但目前尚未形成规模效应”。

该机构将“暂停令”定义为一种临时性法律冻结，绝大多数情况下是“停止受理新的申请”。截至今年9月，研究团队在17个州追踪了400多项地方性法规工具，其中已生效的措施包括若干永久性分区禁令。仅今年夏天，纽约、得克萨斯、宾夕法尼亚和俄勒冈四州就在不到两个月内相继采取行动。为逐一核验每项限制措施对数千个项目的实际影响，分析团队动用了“一支由先进研究代理组成的大军”进行逐项目审计。

暂停令之所以效果有限，原因有多方面。首先，此类措施通常不撤销已获批的许可，已开工或完全获准的项目不在其管辖范围内。其次，短期暂停令可能在后续项目需要审批之前就已到期。此外，诉讼程序或设备交付周期本身已构成项目时间表的主要约束，暂停令只有在同时满足多个条件时才能真正改变交付日期：必须覆盖到具体地块、在项目审批窗口期内有效、与项目时间线重叠，且限制的使用类型无法被项目方绕开。

具体案例印证了这一判断。密歇根州虽已生效45项暂停令，但对在建项目管线的实际影响几乎为零，谷歌在该州的一个园区就位于已划定为数据处理用途的工业用地上。SpaceX计划在得州布朗斯维尔建设的数据中心，所在地块已被市政府从管辖范围内移除，因而城市暂停令鞭长莫及。宾夕法尼亚州一个乡镇的暂停令则确实发挥了作用——该镇在NorthPoint公司提交特殊例外申请之前就通过了暂停措施，导致地方审批被推迟至明年，但该公司仍在继续推进项目。

值得注意的是，2.3GW这一数字并未纳入得克萨斯州环境质量委员会（TCEQ）的暂停令。得州州长格雷格·阿博特已指示TCEQ停止为数据中心项目发放许可。律师事务所Bracewell指出，该禁令无论项目是否在得州电力可靠性委员会（ERCOT）的并网队列中均适用，预计将持续至ERCOT于12月中旬完成审查。此类由州级层面发起的暂停措施及其执行方式，可能对建设预测产生实质影响。

《经济学人》记者阿奇·霍尔在走访密歇根和俄亥俄后也持类似判断，认为数据中心暂停令目前“雷声大雨点小”。他认为更大的风险在于抑制新项目进入，但这更多影响数据中心的选址分布而非是否建设。政治因素同样不可忽视——SemiAnalysis今年8月的民调显示，对数据中心持负面看法的美国人多于持正面看法者。

分析结论认为，暂停令需要变得“范围更广、限制更严”才足以延迟整体建设进度。报告作者之一杰雷米·埃利亚胡·翁蒂韦罗斯在该机构的播客中表示，真正令人担忧的是州级层面严格到连离网项目都阻止的暂停令，并以得州为例。纽约州州长凯西·霍楚尔与阿博特一样，均找到了绕过立法机构、由行政层面掌控且可随时撤销的暂停手段。下一个值得关注的节点是TCEQ向州长办公室提交的合规报告，截止日期为周一。

history.title: RTX Spark Ignites Global Celebration as New Windows PCs Arrive
history.description: NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops are now available, bringing NVIDIA Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 128GB of unified memory and the full NVIDIA AI platform to slim, premium Windows PCs.  Starting at $2,399, laptops from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI bring powerful local AI, content creation and gaming capabilities to a portable device, with […]
history.content: NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops are now available, bringing NVIDIA Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 128GB of unified memory and the full NVIDIA AI platform to slim, premium Windows PCs. Starting at $2,399, laptops from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI bring powerful local AI, content creation and gaming capabilities to a portable device, with additional systems on the way. NVIDIA celebrated the launch with events around the world, including one in Berlin, where NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang made a surprise appearance. A New Generation of Windows PCs Has Arrived RTX Spark brings decades of NVIDIA accelerated computing innovation into a single superchip, combining an NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU and NVIDIA Grace CPU with up to 1 petaflop of AI compute and up to 128GB of unified memory. Read more in the press release. RTX Spark Launch Celebrations Light Up Berlin The arrival of RTX Spark brought fans, creators and PC enthusiasts together in Berlin during the Festival of Lights, an annual autumn art festival that transforms the German capital’s most famous landmarks, streets and squares into glowing canvases. This year, the festival featured RTX Spark-themed lighting on the Berlin TV Tower. Berlin sparked something special, indeed. Fans gathered hours ahead in anticipation for the launch celebration at XPERION, the gaming venue inside Saturn at Alexanderplatz, where attendees got hands-on with RTX Spark laptops from leading PC makers, exploring the latest gaming experiences, content-creation workflows and local AI capabilities. Even this Geralt cosplayer waited to get his hands on RTX Spark. The celebration included a special appearance by Huang, who greeted an enthusiastic crowd, passed out popcorn and posed for selfies. He also gave out five personally signed RTX Spark laptops. You get a signed RTX Spark. You get a signed RTX Spark. Berlin held one of six RTX Spark retail launch celebrations worldwide. From San Francisco to Seoul: How the World Welcomed RTX Spark A massive crowd gathered at the JD MALL Shuangjing Store in Beijing to celebrate the highly anticipated launch, enjoying a night of innovation and community connection. Crowds gathered to demo RTX Spark at the Beijing RTX Spark launch party. Attendees at Vatan Bilgisayar Topkapı in Istanbul experienced a lively event filled with interactive demonstrations and specialized programming led by local creators. Attendees witnessed local celebrities speak at the RTX Spark launch party in Istanbul. Seoul’s COEX East Lobby transformed into a bustling hub of creativity, hosting an eager crowd for engaging hands-on demos and captivating evening sessions dedicated to gaming and AI. Hands-on demos at the RTX Spark launch party in Seoul. Tech enthusiasts in San Francisco visited the local Best Buy store for an unforgettable morning of hands-on RTX Spark demos, fireside chats with local founders and a special appearance by tech influencer iJustine. Lines were long but lively at the San Francisco RTX Spark launch party. The energy at Muse Garden in Taipei was electric as the local AI community came together for a vibrant evening of music, engaging discussions and incredible product showcases. Incredible atmosphere at the Taipei RTX Spark launch party. Developers and AI enthusiasts can explore NVIDIA-tested recipes, playbooks and resources for running local AI on RTX Spark. Follow NVIDIA RTX Spark on X, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook — and stay informed by subscribing to the NVIDIA Local AI newsletter. Follow NVIDIA Workstation on LinkedIn and X. See notice regarding software product information.

history.titleZh: RTX Spark点燃全球庆典，全新Windows PC上市
history.descriptionZh:
NVIDIA 宣布 RTX Spark 笔记本电脑正式上市，将 Blackwell RTX 显卡、最高 128GB 统一内存以及完整的 NVIDIA AI 平台带入纤薄的高端 Windows PC。新品起售价为 2,399 美元，首批来自 ASUS、Dell、HP、Lenovo、Microsoft 和 MSI，后续还会有更多机型推出。NVIDIA 称，RTX Spark 面向本地 AI、内容创作和游戏等场景，旨在让高性能 AI 能力从云端延伸到便携设备。

从技术架构看，RTX Spark 将 NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU 与 NVIDIA Grace CPU 集成到单一“超级芯片”中，最高提供 1 petaflop AI 算力和 128GB 统一内存。统一内存的核心意义在于让 CPU、GPU 共享同一内存池，减少传统架构中频繁的数据拷贝和内存分区限制，从而更高效地运行大型本地 AI 模型、复杂创作工作流和图形负载，并改善能效与响应速度。NVIDIA 表示，这一设计把其数十年加速计算创新浓缩到一台 PC 中，使本地 AI 推理、生成式 AI 应用、内容制作和游戏可在更纤薄的设备上完成。

价格方面，RTX Spark 笔记本起售价 2,399 美元，定位高端 premium Windows PC。其卖点不只是传统显卡性能，而是“AI PC”形态：通过最高 128GB 统一内存和最高 1 petaflop AI 算力，支持更大参数模型和更复杂的本地 AI 任务，同时兼顾游戏与创意生产。NVIDIA 还面向开发者和 AI 爱好者提供经过 NVIDIA 测试的 recipes、playbooks 和资源，帮助用户在 RTX Spark 上运行本地 AI。

NVIDIA 在全球多地举办 RTX Spark 上市庆祝活动。柏林站结合“灯光节”，在柏林电视塔呈现 RTX Spark 主题灯光；粉丝在 Alexanderplatz 的 Saturn 内 XPERION 游戏场馆提前数小时排队，体验来自各大 PC 厂商的 RTX Spark 笔记本、游戏体验、内容创作工作流和本地 AI 能力。NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO 黄仁勋意外现身，与人群互动、分发爆米花、合影自拍，并送出五台亲笔签名 RTX Spark 笔记本。

柏林是全球六场 RTX Spark 零售上市庆祝活动之一。其他活动包括：北京 JD MALL 双井店的大型发布活动；伊斯坦布尔 Vatan Bilgisayar Topkapı 的互动演示和本地创作者编程活动；首尔 COEX 东大厅的游戏与 AI 动手演示及晚间专场；旧金山 Best Buy 的清晨体验、与本地创始人的炉边谈话以及科技网红 iJustine 的特别亮相；台北 Muse Garden 面向本地 AI 社区的音乐、讨论和产品展示。整体来看，RTX Spark 的发布标志着 NVIDIA 将其 GPU、CPU 和 AI 软件生态进一步整合到 Windows PC 形态中，瞄准高端创作者、开发者和游戏玩家，并推动本地 AI 从概念走向可购买、可体验的终端设备。
